name: Steady
text: Every stat holds a floor of three.

name: Bloodhound
text: Add two on the last check of every stage.

name: Unkillable
text: Once a quest you survive the blow that would kill you.

name: Ironlung
text: You carry two more Strain before you fall.

name: Quickstudy
text: Add one on any stat you have not rolled yet this quest.

name: Surehanded
text: A natural one is rolled again, on every stat.

name: Bulwark
text: Two more Armor to soak the hurt before it lands.

name: Grim
text: After an ally dies, add two on every check this quest.

name: Ninth Hour
text: Add three on every check at the boss.

name: Untethered
text: Ambush never falls on you.

name: Deepdrawn
text: Your highest stat surges one face sooner.

name: Steadfast
text: Contagion from an ally who fails NERVE never reaches you.

name: Tollworn
text: The Toll takes no Strain from you on the way in.

name: Chainborn
text: Add two on every check within a Chain.

name: Handfast
text: Add two on a Relay check, your hand in an ally's.

name: Keyfinger
text: Add two on a Vault, whatever stat you bring to the lock.

name: Firstfoot
text: Add two on the first check resolved in every stage.

name: Afterguard
text: After an ally fails, your next check that stage adds two.

name: Two Hearts
text: Your first NERVE check each stage rolls twice, keeps the higher.

name: Steelgrip
text: MIGHT rolls a natural one again, and adds one at the boss.

name: Warmblood
text: Under Shivering your floors hold, up to three.

name: Farlantern
text: Hidden TNs show to you, and the next stage shows its stats early.

name: Hollowvein
text: Your first Push each stage takes no Strain.

name: Deepsleeper
text: When you bench, you clear one more Strain.
